subject.title: Export installed agents as grouped Claw packages

question: Should `claws export` require verified complete installed state by default, with any drifted/partial export offered only as a separately named snapshot mode?
rationale: This determines the public meaning and compatibility contract of exported Claw packages; it cannot be resolved mechanically from tests because both strict reproducibility and explicit snapshot portability are plausible products.

options.title: Strict export by default
options.body: Require complete verified state and reject drift or partial provenance; add snapshot behavior later only with explicit format and UX design.

options.title: Add an explicit snapshot mode now
options.body: Keep strict export as the default but add a separately named mode that emits drift metadata and lineage for incomplete state.

options.title: Defer export from the stack
options.body: Pause this slice until the lifecycle and package-format contracts are merged and the export semantics can be decided on current main.

recommendation.title: Strict export by default
recommendation.body: Require complete verified state and reject drift or partial provenance; add snapshot behavior later only with explicit format and UX design.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review comment states the concrete reproducibility and snapshot tradeoff that needs product confirmation.
